subject: Request: KMS/HSM evidence and key rotation logs for NimbusCloud SIG
messages:
From: Evan Zhou <evan.zhou@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SIG request – KMS/HSM artifacts and rotation logs

Hi Logan,

Thanks for taking our SIG intake. Nimbus is collecting evidence ahead of our vendor review next week and we need the following items scoped to Redwood's hosted offering:

- HSM attestation (latest available)
- Key rotation logs for master and data-encryption keys (12 months)
- BYOK handshake / import logs for our tenant if available
- Short write-up on how in-transit and at-rest encryption are enforced across Dedicated/Hosted variants

Can you confirm what you can provide and an estimated delivery window? We prefer the artifacts in a single ZIP with a manifest.

Appreciate it — Evan
Evan Zhou
Sr. Compliance Engineer, NimbusCloud
(evan.zhou@nimbuscloud.com)
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 May 2025 10:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: SIG request – KMS/HSM artifacts and rotation logs

Folks — forwarding Nimbus's ask. High priority: they want HSM attestation + 12 months of rotation logs and BYOK handshake. Target: bundle and ship by EOD Wednesday 14 May.

Marissa — can you own the ZIP and drive the upload to Drive, HubSpot link in metadata?
Soojin — can you pull the rotation logs + HSM attestation and redact anything tenant-sensitive? If we have a tenant-specific BYOK import record for Nimbus, include a handshake.txt stub, otherwise include the BYOK flow notes and timestamps.
Monica — FYI for SOC traceability; please keep a copy for our evidence registry.

Deliverables:
- kms_rotation_logs_2024-2025.csv (redwood tokenized user IDs)
- hsm_attestation_2025-05-01.pdf (vendor attestation, redactions applied)
- byok_onboarding_handshake.txt (timestamped events)
- encryption-processes-summary.md (short explainer + sequence diagrams)

I'll coordinate with Nimbus on any follow-ups.

Thanks,
Logan Wright
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference
log@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0199
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 May 2025 15:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: SIG request – KMS/HSM artifacts and rotation logs

Hi all — assembling artifacts now. Quick notes on scope decisions we made while pulling items:

1) HSM attestation: included vendor PDF (hsm_attestation_2025-05-01.pdf). Sensitive serials redacted; attestation still indicates FIPS 140-2 level and signing cert chain.

2) Rotation logs: exported master+data-key events for 2024-05 through 2025-04. Sensitive key identifiers are pseudonymized; timestamps and operator IDs retained. File: kms_rotation_logs_2024-2025.csv (columns: event_time, key_type, action, operator_id_pseudonym, result).

3) BYOK handshake: Nimbus was onboarded as a BYOK customer in 2024-11; included a compact event log (byok_onboarding_handshake.txt) showing the import operation, verification steps, and KMS response codes. We did not include the raw customer key material.

4) Encryption processes write-up: encryption-processes-summary.md — short explanations for in-transit (TLS 1.2+/mTLS option) and at-rest (AES-256 with per-tenant DEKs wrapped by KMS CMKs). Also call out Dedicated vs Hosted differences and fallback policies for rotation failures.

Attachments will be zipped and uploaded to the shared Drive link Logan requested. ETA: Wednesday 14 May 11:00am PT.

If Nimbus asks for unredacted artifacts for a signed NDA, escalate to Legal and Security — note in the manifest which files are redacted.

— Soojin
Soojin Lee
Senior Security Engineer, Redwood Inference
soojin@redwood.com
From: Evan Zhou <evan.zhou@nimbuscloud.com>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com>
Cc: NimbusCloud Compliance Team <sig@nimbuscloud.com>
Date: Wed, 14 May 2025 16:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: SIG request – KMS/HSM artifacts and rotation logs

Logan / team — thanks, we received the Drive link and verified the manifest. Downloads completed. Quick clarifying question: in the rotation CSV, operator IDs are pseudonymized — can you confirm the mapping exists in case our audit needs to correlate with access logs? We understand mappings require higher clearance; please advise the process.

If needed, we can initiate an NDA escalation to get a controlled mapping for the audit window. Otherwise the current evidence set looks sufficient for our preliminary SIG review.

Best,
Evan
On Wed, 14 May 2025 at 16:46, Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.com> wrote:

> Hi Evan,
>
> Thanks for the quick check. Confirmed — we maintain a sealed mapping in our compliance vault (requires Legal + Security approval to release). I'll start the internal request if Nimbus wants the mapping and will loop Legal. In the meantime, let us know if the redacted set passes the initial SIG gating.
>
> Cheers,
> Logan
